claims.text: en: Appeal to ignorance; định nghĩa: đúng vì chưa ai chứng minh sai (hoặc ngược lại)

sources.quote: Not knowing that a certain statement is true is taken to be a proof that it is false.
because there is no evidence against it

claims.text: not_fallacy_when: đã tìm kiếm kỹ bằng phương pháp đủ mạnh mà không thấy

sources.quote: It would be proper reasoning only if the proof attempts were quite thorough
The fallacy occurs in cases where absence of evidence is not good enough evidence of absence.
